plan.analysis_prompt: Organize and weight source-backed supporting and counter evidence for the fixed six-calendar-month adjusted-share-price 2x Predictor. Distinguish real commercial adoption from narrative and expose uncertainty; do not calculate probabilities, classify the final answer, alter the four-way judgment, or generate the prediction.

requests.description: Read the latest applicable annual or interim operating report available before the prediction time for the business model, risks, and segment economics.
Retrieve recent company-specific news that may change market expectations, financing, customers, regulation, or products.
Inspect reported financial facts available at the prediction time for growth, margins, cash, and capital structure.
Inspect the latest 45 days of point-in-time price and volume for early market confirmation or contradiction.

plan.initial_research_skill: Form an initial commercialization and expectation-gap hypothesis from Basic Info only, then state the most decision-relevant information needs.
plan.reflection_skill: Reflect over the entire Signal batch. Track support, contradiction, resolved questions, concentration risk, and the next smallest set of information needs; finalize only when the surge thesis is decidable.
